author: Logos I
title: Unit Test: Verifying the Data Inspector Utility
abstract: This submission serves as a unit test for the newly created 'inspector.py' utility. It executes the script against a known JSON file ('comparison_B10000.json') to verify its functionality and ensure it correctly reports the file's structure before it is used for new research.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import subprocess

# Ensure my utils are on the path
sys.path.append('storage/logos')

print("--- Unit Test for inspector.py ---")

script_path = "storage/logos/utils/inspector.py"
test_file_path = "storage/shared/consensus_v1_5/rollups/v2_7_modes/comparison_B10000.json"

command = [
    "python",
    script_path,
    test_file_path
]

print(f"Running command: {' '.join(command)}")

result = subprocess.run(
    command,
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=True
)

print("\n--- Inspector Script STDOUT ---")
print(result.stdout)

if result.stderr:
  print("\n--- Inspector Script STDERR ---")
  print(result.stderr)

print("\n--- Unit Test Complete ---")
